event_data.context: Filesystem journal merged in PR #4. Signed PR #5 head 89ac5ae preserves the ancestry of imported empty decisions and uses an ordered ownership pass plus a reverse frontier walk. Full local gate passed 29 tests. The new test checks actual branch payloads after a third claim arrives. On a local 800-write resolved suffix, fork inspection fell from about 526 ms to 1.7 ms. Both review threads are resolved and fresh App review is pending. Rust issue https://github.com/jwilger/eventcore/issues/45 is open. The clean SQLCipher prototype passed 33 tests.
event_data.summary: Port and verify the durable storage and command state capabilities of EventCore 2.1.0 on Erlang/OTP.
